name: Norma
source:
The oldest patient in the clinic.
A perpetually-sleepy Persian cat who lives life slowly. She enjoys reading, and may be unexpectedly intelligent?
Her condition is an excessive libido. She's not only aware of going into heat, she enjoys it. Once this "switch" in her is activated, she goes from carefree to sexy in an instant.
